sentences.text:
Through: Mr. Ravi Ranjan and Mr.
 Kumar, Advocates.
 versus
 State Of Nct & Anr. .

Through: Ms. Priyanka Dalal, App
 with Si Anbur and Insp.
 Nihal Vihar.

HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJNISH BHATNAGAR  ORDER % 21.04.2023 1. Exemption allowed subject to just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

3. This is a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of FIR No. 977/2022, under Section 376(2)(n)/506 IPC, registered at Police Station Nihal Vihar, Delhi, and all proceedings emanating therefrom.
Learned APP for the State appears on advance notice and accepts notice.

5. Let status report be filed before the next date of hearing.
6.
Respondent no. 2 is present in person.
Respondent no. 2 states that she is poor and cannot afford a private counsel and requests the Court to provide a counsel at the expense of the State.
7. Accordingly, Delhi High Court Legal Services Committee is directed to provide a legal aid counsel to the respondent no. 2.

entities.text: Delhi High Court Legal Services Committee
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
A copy of the paperbook be supplied to the newly appointed legal aid counsel before the next date of hearing.
8. List on 18th August 2023.
